---

## What does this mod do?

Tired of slowly unlocking recipes over dozens of in-game days? This mod lets you learn [b]every single crafting and cooking recipe in the game[/b] with a single key press — instantly, no strings attached.

One button. Every recipe. Done.

---

[size=4]Features[/size]

- 🍳 [b]Unlocks all cooking recipes[/b] — every dish, every meal, all at once
- 🔨 [b]Unlocks all crafting recipes[/b] — every item, tool upgrade, and station
- ⌨️ [b]Customizable keybind[/b] — use whatever key feels right to you
- 💬 [b]In-game confirmation[/b] — a pop-up tells you how many recipes you just learned
- 🔁 [b]Safe to press anytime[/b] — already know everything? It'll just let you know

---
[size=4]
How to use it[/size]

1. Load up your save file
2. Press [b]R[/b] on your keyboard
3. That's it — every recipe is now yours!

Want to change the key? Head to the mod's `config.json` file and swap `"R"` for whatever key you prefer.

---
[size=4]
Requirements[/size]

- SMAPI — the modding tool that makes Stardew mods work
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later

If you've never installed a Stardew mod before, check out this beginner's guide: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started — it's easier than it sounds!

---

[size=4]Installation[/size]

1. Install SMAPI if you haven't already
2. Download this mod
3. Unzip the folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` directory
4. Launch the game through SMAPI as usual

---
[size=4]
Compatibility[/size]

- ✅ Works with existing saves
- ✅ Works alongside other mods
- ✅ Multiplayer safe (only affects your character)

---

[size=4]A note from OD Mods[/size]

This mod was made for players who don't want to do the infamous Stardew recipe grind — whether you're on a new playthrough, helping a friend, or just want to experiment in the kitchen and workshop without waiting. Enjoy! 🌱
